verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with a case platform that handles uploaded documents, so a policy against using customer data for AI training is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, a training opt-out, or any data-use policy. The pricing, visa-pathway, blog and probe items are all unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
